prompts.ottawa: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent hero artwork for an existing playful city carousel called SOFT SPOT. Create one beautifully crafted 3D miniature city diorama, an editorial architectural collectible rendered in exquisite detail, not a flat illustration. Square canvas, true transparent background with alpha, no sky or backdrop. One cohesive compact floating island with a shallow rounded organically shaped base and a gently beveled edge. Elevated three-quarter/isometric camera about 30 degrees down, orthographic perspective. Whole diorama visible with 8 percent transparent margin including the tallest spire. Soft warm studio light from upper left, ambient occlusion within buildings, crisp tiny windows and trees, realistic stone, glass and water with tasteful slightly toy-like proportions. Buildings should read as recognizable landmarks; no invented fantasy towers. Keep the underside of the island shallow, no rocky floating mountain. No text, labels, city name, typography, logos, watermark, animals, people or cast shadow outside the island. Subtle visual hierarchy, one obvious hero landmark, rich warm accents, polished premium visual quality. Subject: OTTAWA, Ontario, Canada. Parliament Hill with the recognizable Gothic Revival Centre Block and its tall Peace Tower, pale warm limestone and patinated copper roofs; a carefully detailed sequence of the Rideau Canal stone lock chambers with still teal water descending toward a broad sliver of Ottawa River; a compact cluster of low-rise red-brick heritage buildings, green trees, a few copper and autumn amber maple trees, winding pedestrian paths. Arrange Parliament on a gently raised grassy terrace behind the canal. The base is a pale limestone island with teal river edge. Capture a tranquil capital-city atmosphere and restrained warm green/copper palette. One coherent miniature city, not multiple separate floating objects.
